statements.status_notes: RUSTSEC-2026-0204 is an invalid pointer dereference in the fmt::Pointer implementation for Atomic and Shared in crossbeam-epoch 0.9.x before 0.9.20; the Debug implementations are not affected. crossbeam-epoch 0.9.18 is compiled into rust-analyzer through crossbeam-deque, its only dependent in the lock file, but crossbeam-deque 0.8.6 only has Debug implementations of its own types (Worker, Stealer, Injector, Steal) and never formats an Atomic or Shared, and the only occurrence of a pointer format specifier in the src/tools/rust-analyzer workspace of Rust 1.100.0 is in hir-def's parser for format strings, which does not format values. Advisory: https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0204.html

RUSTSEC-2026-0204 is an invalid pointer dereference in the fmt::Pointer implementation for Atomic and Shared in crossbeam-epoch 0.9.x before 0.9.20. crossbeam-epoch appears in the SBOM because the Cargo.lock of flux v0.201.0 lists it, but it is not compiled into Kapacitor. Its only dependent in the lock file is crossbeam-deque, which comes in through rayon-core and rayon. flux-core declares rayon as an optional dependency that only its `doc` feature enables. criterion, a dev-dependency of flux and flux-core, also depends on rayon, but `cargo build` does not build dev-dependencies. Kapacitor builds libflux with `cargo build --release --no-default-features --features=cffi`, and flux v0.201.0 depends on flux-core with default-features = false, so `doc` is off. The amd64 kapacitord binary contains no symbols from the crossbeam_epoch or crossbeam_deque crate, while the crates that are compiled in (anyhow, chrono, libflate, parking_lot_core) do.
